title: Classic pivot levels — target, stall and reversal falsification

dataset.analysis_timeframe: H1 trend state and M15 first-passage/reaction bars derived from M1

hypotheses.market_question: Do daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly and yearly classic pivot coordinates act as distinctive price targets, containment/stall points, trend terminals or reversal points?
hypotheses.null: Exact pivot coordinates are not incrementally different from deterministic nearby placebo coordinates after distance/opportunity controls.
hypotheses.alternative: Exact pivots show stronger target/stall/terminal/reversal behavior than nearby placebo coordinates.
hypotheses.mechanism: Widely followed prior-period-derived levels may concentrate expectations/orders and therefore alter local price behavior.

method.primary_endpoint: P1-P4 exact-pivot versus placebo effect family across daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly and yearly pivots; P0 fresh-touch census descriptive only.
method.economic_effect_size: Exact-pivot minus placebo effect for each predeclared mechanism.
method.event_definition: Classic floor pivots; daily/weekly test S3-S1, PP, R1-R3; monthly/quarterly/yearly additionally test six arithmetic midlevels; New York 17:00 DST-safe periods. A coordinate is reached when derived M15 high/low first enters its causal tolerance zone, whose half-width is min(25 pips, 0.10*lagged prior ATR20_D1, 0.10*local pivot spacing), with the preregistered numerical floor/anti-overlap rule.
controls: Each exact level compared with deterministic nearby placebo coordinates shifted ±25% of local pivot spacing; the same tolerance-zone construction applies.

inference.multiple_testing: Holm correction across 20 primary hypotheses (P1-P4 × five timeframes)

execution.same_bar_policy: same-M15 target/failure or reversal/extension crossings classified ambiguous/non-success

holdout.prior_exposure: none for this pivot programme before internal 2015-2021 study

provenance.notes: Exact programme decision, tolerance geometry and ±25%-of-local-spacing placebo construction preserved from immutable branch evidence.
